other_conditions: Candidates who have already undergone this training are not eligible to apply.
Educational qualifications should meet the standards specified by the Training Units/Institutions.
Applicant must be a native of Puducherry or have been a continuous resident for the past 3 years.
benefits_summary: Trainees receive a monthly stipend of ₹2,500 with accommodation support of ₹500 and travel allowance; full course fees are paid by the scheme.
